summary: The newcomer invites a colleague to lunch instead of waiting to be asked.
realLife: First-week guidance says to look for a buddy or mentor and to invite coworkers to lunch rather than wait for an invitation. Follow-up questions about what the coworker just said read as more engaged.
sources: Atlassian Work Life, starting a new job and first week success: https://www.atlassian.com/blog/teamwork/starting-a-new-job-and-first-week-success
inGame: New-coworker event plus the person's tie to the player (coworker) and traits such as shy or outgoing; no lunch mechanic, so it needs: a meal or break scene hook.
